decisions.summary: the check skips a recorded review verdict (any plan-review.json), as the reviewer's words
decisions.why: Not in FR-017's list, so a narrowing; legitimate because a verdict that reports a stale pointer must quote it, and rewriting it falsifies the record (this round's commit did exactly that: the round-4 finding now describes the fix as the defect). It is the same class FR-017 already exempts, a verbatim record (the replay corpora), and no reader follows it to a research file, which is what message 3 asks to land. Measured: of 61 tracked plan-review.json files, only 303's own carries any retired form, so the exemption hides no live reference
